# Garnier Whole Blends Softening Shampoo Bar, Oat Delicacy

Swap your bottle for a bar that cleanses, softens, and lathers like liquid shampoo. Made for fine to normal hair, this Oat Delicacy bar hydrates as it cleans, leaving strands soft and manageable.

## Features Built for Everyday Use

- Lathers into a rich foam from a small amount of product
- Formulated with 94% plant-based ingredients
- Paraben-free, with no silicones, preservatives, soap, or dyes
- Lasts up to 40 washes
- 97% biodegradable and fast-rinsing
- Leaping Bunny certified and cruelty-free

## Benefits You Will Notice

Hold the bar and lather directly in your hands, so kids and first-time users can wash with more control and less drip. Its compact, solid form also fits your travel plans, so you can pack a shampoo that skips the liquid restrictions at airport security. Rinsing clears quickly, making your wash routine faster.

## Plastic-Free Care

Zero plastic packaging means less waste in your bathroom. The box is 100% recyclable and Forest Stewardship Council certified, so you can choose a sustainable option without sacrificing lather.

## Why Shoppers Choose It

Shoppers often praise the rich lather, easy rinse, and value of a well-known brand at $7.97. For best results, follow with your favorite Garnier Whole Blends conditioner for added nourishment. Add Oat Delicacy to your cart today and experience a shampoo bar for yourself.
